source_document_review.finding: Lists LIBRARY syntax; no general EXE archive-extraction or unused-member rule found.
Shows LIBRARY use and compiler-embedded MSC library names; no ordinary-link member-selection algorithm stated.
Lines 59-64 describe unresolved-symbol/UNDEFINE selection when generating an RTL; this is not evidence for normal EXE extraction.
Lines 66-74 describe regular-library lookup for unresolved symbols while generating an RTL; not a general normal-EXE rule.

OMF TIS pp. 12, 19: class A2 is a pass-separator comment and class A3 is LIBMOD metadata recording a library/module name; these records do not establish an RTLink extraction directive. The post-LIB custom member comments confirm LIB inserted the A3 module-name record.

interpretation.generic_unreferenced_member_autoload: Not observed for the tested ordinary C-built data-only or code+data members with either RTLink 4.00 or 6.10; v37a repeats this after a clean, successful LIB 3.17 creation and consistency check.
interpretation.referenced_member_control: A live reference to initialized data or a function in a code+data member extracts that member under both linkers.
interpretation.natural_main_baseline: Both linkers select fdata in the clean natural-main control; pinned OMF fixups show stdalloc->_malloc, malloc->__fmalloc, and fmalloc->__fheap, with fdata defining __fheap.
interpretation.comdef_only_control: The live reference to a COMDEF-only library member stays undefined under both linkers; this is a limitation/control result, not an initialized data-only positive.
interpretation.application_rtlink610_fdata: The current186 partial 6.10 run selects fdata.asm alone; this control excludes generic unreferenced-member autoload but does not determine the app-specific trigger or any transient linker-internal selection/discard behavior.
